environment: Chromium SwiftShader, 640x480, pixel ratio 1; software elapsed queries are not hardware GPU timings.
method: Fresh runtime per case; 60 warmup frames; 240 stationary and 120 frames each walking, running and backtracking. Frame-stepped movement: 0.06 and 0.18 m/frame, not wall-clock player speed. Three alternating pairs for terrain-enabled cases; one pair for controls. Async GPU samples counted only when newly completed. Readback outside timings.
